_doc: Per-class world scale and LOD0 triangle budget for the mesh lane (finish.mjs, mesh-card.mjs). Triangles are the unit everywhere. Each number cites where it comes from; change it there first, then here.

components._source: speckShare 0.5 % = apps/vr/tools/assets/finish.py drop_small_components(hm, 0.005) and the ai-registry game-production floater-vs-part-face-share-rule default; speckMinFaces 8 = the same rule's absolute minimum

finish._source: the Brennic rebuild line in apps/vr/art/characters/brennic/HANDOFF.md: finish.py ... Brennic 0 4096 0.01 24000 (bakeRes: the flat mode's classification bake). bakeTextureRes: the shipped base-colour texture of --mode bake, chosen in docs/research/BRENNIC-MESH-REWORK-2026-10-24.md (texel density against the Quest 3 view at the duel distance, and room for UE to downsample to 1024 on device)

_source.heightM: apps/vr/tasks/T38-first-animated-opponent.md Wolf check 'unit scale matching FBody' (the FBody mage is 180 cm, HANDOFF.md check 8); finish.py HEIGHT default 1.8
_source.heightTolerance: apps/vr/tools/assets/metrics.py check 8 'unit scale, height 1.62-1.98 m' (1.8 m +-10 %)
_source.tris: apps/vr/tools/assets/metrics.py TRI_BUDGET_LOD0 = (18000, 30000) (HANDOFF.md check 4 'target 18-30k'); target 24000 = the HANDOFF.md rebuild line
_source.partsMax: ai-registry game-production structural-scorecard: a part budget of 8 is the starting point for characters
_source.specksMax: ai-registry game-production structural-scorecard: a speck tolerance of 4 is the starting point for characters
_source.palette: the default finish.py palette set (concept-front-s3801-medium.jpg); pass --palette for another figure

_source.heightM: apps/vr/tools/assets/metrics.py BEASTS CinderHound height 1.36 (finish.py: sheet 05 side view, 473 px at 2.875 mm/px)
_source.tris: metrics.py BEASTS CinderHound tris 12000, 'three hounds on screen at once'; the check is 0 < tris <= budget, so min 1 and target = the budget

_source.heightM: apps/vr/tools/assets/metrics.py BEASTS MireMaw height 1.25 (finish.py: sheet 06, 435 px)
_source.tris: metrics.py BEASTS MireMaw tris 20000, 'one maw'; the check is 0 < tris <= budget, so min 1 and target = the budget
